component.name: Librefood
component.summary: Configurable food scores from Open Food Facts

description.p: Librefood looks up products in the public Open Food Facts database (barcode, search, or webcam scan) and scores them with transparent, user-editable scoring profiles. Source OFF data is kept separate from derived scores.
Create and switch profiles with weights, thresholds, caps, and missing-data policies. Inspect step-by-step explanations. Custom scores are not official Nutri-Score grades and are not medical advice.
Configurable scoring engine, profile management, logo branding, explainable results.
Initial release: barcode lookup, live camera preview, Nutri-Score display.
